subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Session Architecture: Shared LLM + Isolated Sessions + Public Knowledge Base

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the umbrella RFC for multi-session architecture, or supersede it with narrower product-approved trackers for routing, session UI, and shared memory?
rationale: Current main implements several adjacent primitives, but automation cannot choose the permanent all-channel session model, config surface, storage migration, or public-memory privacy boundary safely.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split work
options.body: Use this issue for architecture coordination while moving accepted slices into focused session-routing, UI lifecycle, and memory/security issues.

options.title: Supersede with narrower issues
options.body: Close this umbrella after pointing users to active narrower issues for topic-session families, Topic/Session UI, and per-agent inbound routing.

options.title: Reject broad core architecture
options.body: Close the RFC as too broad for OpenClaw core unless a missing plugin or session API gap is proven first.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split work
recommendation.body: Use this issue for architecture coordination while moving accepted slices into focused session-routing, UI lifecycle, and memory/security issues.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and history put the most relevant session protocol, routing, and Control UI lifecycle surfaces under this contributor's recent work.
